hsv_filter

HSV Color Filter Implementation

This module defines an HSV (Hue-Saturation-Value) color filter used for object detection in the TurtleBot soccer player system. The filter uses threshold values to identify specific color ranges in the HSV color space.

The HSVFilter class is implemented as a dataclass for convenient storage and access to filter parameters.

hsv_filter.h_thresh

Hue threshold value (range 0-180 in OpenCV)

Type:

float

hsv_filter.s_thresh

Saturation threshold value (range 0-255)

Type:

float

hsv_filter.v_thresh

Value (brightness) threshold value (range 0-255)

Type:

float

hsv_filter.h_ref

Reference hue value for color comparison

Type:

float

The filter is used by the ImageProcessor to isolate specific colored objects (ball and goal(gate) posts(pins)) in the camera feed by creating binary masks based on these threshold values.

Note: In OpenCV’s implementation of HSV: - Hue ranges from 0-180 (instead of 0-360) - Saturation and Value range from 0-255
